'''Keryt''' was the first [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Zelos system/Legends|Zelos system]],<ref name="PoG2" /> located in the [[Tyus sector/Legends|Tyus sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="TEA-OC" /> It was a barren rock world without a [[Moon/Legends|moon]].<ref name="PoG2" />
